style: epic fantasy illustration, painterly, warm candlelight and parchment tones, cinematic lighting, rich detail, vertical composition, no text, no letters, no logos

characters.Aragorn: a tall lean man in his fifties with a salt-and-pepper braided beard, a thin scar through the left eyebrow, deep-set grey eyes, a dark green travelling cloak fastened with a silver clasp shaped like a gate, a thin iron circlet, worn leather armour
characters.Pepe: a young green frog traveller standing upright, large friendly eyes, a patched brown hooded cloak, a rolled map tucked under one arm, small leather satchel
characters.Gandalf: an old wizard with a long white beard and bushy eyebrows, pale grey robes, a tall crooked wooden staff with a faintly glowing crystal, a wide-brimmed grey hat
characters.Samwise: a sturdy, round-faced traveller with curly brown hair, a heavy canvas pack, a rope coil and a cooking pan tied on, a green waistcoat
characters.Elrond: a calm, ageless lord with long dark hair and a silver band across his forehead, flowing deep blue robes with leaf embroidery
characters.Boromir: a broad-shouldered warrior with short dark hair and a trimmed beard, battered steel armour with a white tree emblem, a great horn at his belt, a round shield
characters.Legolas: a slender archer with long pale-gold braided hair, a leaf-green tunic, a long white bow and a quiver of grey-feathered arrows
characters.Eomer: a horse-captain with a golden beard, a bronze helm with a white horse-hair plume, a red cloak and a long spear
characters.Eowyn: a fierce shield-maiden with a long golden braid, a dented steel cap, a white and green tunic, a sword and a small round shield
characters.Faramir: a thoughtful captain with brown hair and a short beard, a green hooded cloak, a plain steel sword, quiet watchful eyes
characters.Saruman: a tall robed lord with a thin white beard and a high forehead, long white-and-silver robes, a black staff topped with a pale orb
characters.Tom Bombadil: a cheerful old man with a long brown beard, a bright blue coat, yellow boots and a tall blue hat with a long swan feather
characters.Merry: a small brave traveller with sandy hair, a brown jerkin, a short sword and a small round shield
characters.Pippin: a small cheerful traveller with unruly dark curls, a grey-green travelling cloak, a silver leaf brooch
characters.Theoden: an old king with long white hair and a gold circlet, a heavy fur-lined mantle, a gold-hilted sword
characters.Frodo: a small, slight traveller with dark hair and pale tired eyes, a grey cloak, a thin chain with a small ring at the neck
characters.Bilbo: an elderly small scribe with white hair, round spectacles, an ink-stained waistcoat and a huge leather-bound book
characters.Gollum: a thin, pale, wide-eyed creature with a hunched back, large ears and long thin fingers, a tattered loincloth
characters.Treebeard: a giant walking tree with a bark-covered face, mossy beard-like hanging moss, branch arms and deep slow amber eyes
characters.Gimli: a stout dwarf with a long braided red-brown beard, an iron helm with a horned crest, chain mail and a broad-bladed axe
characters.Galadriel: a luminous lady with long pale-gold hair, a flowing white gown, a slender silver circlet and a faint glow around her hands
